blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Consolidating specialized foundation models into a unified generalist is a central goal of post-training. Two approaches are in common use: model merging, which is fast but treated as a heuristic, and multi-teacher on-policy distillation, which matches distributions but demands heavy rollout compute and suffers from cross-task gradient conflict. We show that the two are one objective seen at different orders. Within a shared basin of homologous specialists, the multi-teacher on-policy distillation objective is, to second order, exactly the Fisher-merging objective. Its minimizer is therefore the Fisher merge, a classic model-merging method given by a closed-form combination of the specialists, so merging is optimal, to second order, as a closed-form stage of distillation. Building on this identification, we propose Residual-Governed Branch-and-Merge(RGBM), a two-phase consolidation procedure. Concretely, a full-parameter Fisher merge is intractable on foundation models, so Phase~1 restricts the merge to the task-vector subspace. Extending tangent-space analyses of merging, we show that the same coefficients that mix task vectors also mix implicit rewards, which lets a residual program on unlabelled prompts solve for them. The program minimizes the worst per-domain residual and reports its energy-normalized values as the domain residual spectrum. Phase~2 lets this spectrum govern what may be added: RGBM passivates domains with low normalized residuals, trains isolated branches only for domains above the spectral gap, and writes back the admitted updates with calibrated shrinkage. On two open-source consolidation suites, the Phase~1 merge alone matches or outperforms fully trained multi-teacher distillation, and RGBM improves on it further with zero extra joint-training steps, whereas every un-gated write-back, including continued joint distillation from the merge, falls below it.
blocks.zh: 将专业基础模型整合为统一的通论者是后培训的中心目标. 两种方法是常用的:模式合并(模式合并速度快,但被视为一种heuristic)和多教师政策蒸馏(多教师政策蒸馏),它们匹配分布,但需要大量推出计算,并有跨任务梯度冲突. 我们显示,两者是在不同命令中看到的一个目标。 在一个共同的同源专家盆地内,多教师政策提炼的目标,第二顺序是,正是费舍尔-合并的目标。 因此它的最小化是费舍尔合并(Fisher),是一种由专家的闭合式组合给出的经典的模型-并发法,所以合并是最佳的到第二顺序,作为蒸馏的闭合式阶段. 根据这一认定,我们提议采用两阶段合并程序 -- -- 余留事项治理处和小组。 具体来说,一个完整的参数费舍尔合并在基础模型上是难以解决的,因此Phase~1将合并限制在任务执行子空间. 扩展合并的切入空间分析,我们显示,混合任务向量的相同系数也混合了隐含的回报,这使得一个未加标签的提示上的剩余程序能够解决它们. 程序将每个域中最差的残基最小化,并报告其能常值为域后遗谱. Phase~2 让这个频谱规范可以添加的: RGBM钝化了低常态残基域,仅为光谱缺口上方域而列车孤立分支,并用校正收缩来回写所接受的更新. 在两个开源合并套件上,Phase~1合并单独匹配或超越了训练有素的多教师蒸馏,RGBM则以零附加联合训练步骤来进一步改进,而每个未加配的回写,包括继续从合并中联合蒸馏,则会低于它.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Post-training of large language models (LLMs) increasingly produces homologous domain specialists—fine-tuned from a common base via reinforcement learning (RL) on distinct reasoning modalities ( Agarwal et al., 2024 ; Shao et al., 2024 ; DeepSeek-AI, 2025 ; Team, 2025a ; Gao et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2025a ) . Serving an ensemble of specialists multiplies memory and latency, making consolidation into a single generalist essential.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)的后期培训越来越多地产生同域专家——通过不同推理模式的强化学习,从共同基础进行精细调整(Agarwal等人,2024年;Shao等人,2024年;DeepSeek-AI,2025年;Team,2025a年;Gao等人,2026年;Liu等人,2025年a年)。 服务于一批专家,使记忆力和耐久性倍增,使整合成为单一的通论家至关重要.

blocks.en: Two paradigms are in common use, each with its own shortcomings. Weight-space merging ( Ilharco et al., 2023 ; Yadav et al., 2023 ; Yu et al., 2024 ; Lu et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2026a ) adds to the base model a weighted sum of the specialists’ weight updates (their task vectors ) at zero training cost, but the weights are set by hand and, once the merge is formed, nothing tells which domain it failed to recover or whether the chosen weights still combine the specialists faithfully. Multi-teacher on-policy distillation ( Agarwal et al., 2024 ; Gao et al., 2026 ; Sun et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026b ; Chen et al., 2026 ) (MOPD) instead trains a student to match each specialist (its teacher ) on the student’s own generations, which repairs what merging misses, but at the cost of rollouts on every domain and with no control over which domains its shared-weight gradients overwrite. Neither paradigm can answer the question the other one raises: what a merge has already recovered, and where distillation is still needed without harming what is already correct. Answering it requires relating the two, which is what this paper does.
blocks.zh: 两个范式是共同使用的,每个都有自己的缺点. 重量-空间合并(Ilharco等人,2023年;Yadav等人,2023年;Yu等人,2024年;Lu等人,2024年;Yang等人,2026a年)在基准模型中增加了专家重量更新的加权总和(他们的任务载体),零训练成本,但权重是手工设定的,一旦合并形成,就没有任何信息可以说明它未能恢复到哪个领域,或者所选择的权重是否仍然忠实地结合了专家. 多教师政策提炼(Agarwal等人,2024年;Gao等人,2026年;Sun等人,2026年;Yang等人,2026年b;Chen等人,2026年b)(MOPD)转而培训一名学生,使其与每名专家(其教师)在学生自己几代人中相匹配,以修复合并缺失之处,但代价是在每个领域展开,无法控制其共同重量梯度覆盖哪个领域。 这两种模式都无法回答另一个模式提出的问题:合并已经恢复了什么,在哪些地方仍然需要蒸馏而不伤害已经正确的东西。 回答这个问题需要将两者联系起来,这就是本文件的作用。

blocks.en: Our starting point is that these paradigms optimize the same objective at different orders of approximation (Section 2 ). Expanded to second order around the specialists in a shared basin, the distillation objective is exactly the Fisher-merging objective of Matena and Raffel (2022) , whose minimizer is a weighted average of the specialists with Fisher-information weights; merging is therefore not an alternative to distillation but is optimal, to second order, as its closed-form stage. A full-parameter Fisher merge is intractable on foundation models, so we restrict the merge to the task-vector subspace (Phase 1, described next). Extending tangent-space analyses of merging, we show that, to first order, the same coefficients that mix the task vectors also mix the specialists’ implicit rewards (the log-probability ratios between each specialist and the base), which lets us obtain them by minimizing the worst reward-space residual on unlabelled prompts. After solving, reward-energy normalization measures the relative share left unrecovered in each domain. The fidelity of this first-order fit provides an intrinsic, label-free test of whether a checkpoint still lies where the expansion holds.
blocks.zh: 我们的出发点是,这些范式在不同近似顺序上优化同一目标(第2节)。 蒸馏目标恰好是Matena和Raffel(2022年)的Fisher-merging目标,后者的最小化是拥有Fisher-信息权重的专家的加权平均值;因此,合并不是蒸馏的替代办法,而是最佳的,而是第二顺序,作为封闭式阶段。 一个完整的参数Fisher合并在基础模型上是难以解决的,因此我们把合并限制在任务执行子空间(第1阶段,下描述). 将合并的切合空间分析扩大,我们显示,首先,混合任务矢量的相同系数也混合了专家的隐含回报(每位专家与基数之间的对数概率比),这使我们能够通过尽量减少无标签提示上最差的奖励空间残留来获得这些回报。 解决后,奖励-能源正常化衡量每个领域的相对份额没有得到恢复。 这种第一顺序的吻合性提供了一个内在的、无标签的测试,以检验是否在扩建时仍然设有检查站。

blocks.en: Grounded in this framework, we propose Residual-Governed Branch-and-Merge (RGBM) as shown in Figure 1 . In Phase 1, RGBM determines the combination weights by minimizing the worst per-domain residual via a small convex program on unlabelled prompts, yielding the zero-training merged model. It then normalizes the residuals by their domain reward energies to form the domain residual spectrum . This spectrum directly dictates what, if anything, should follow the merge. Standard joint distillation tends to degrade the merged model because gradients from domains with low normalized residuals corrupt shared weights. To prevent this interference, Phase 2 leaves those domains untouched and trains isolated branches only for domains above a closed-form spectral gap. Each admitted branch update is then written back, scaled by the largest factor that passes the linearity test.
blocks.zh: 基于这一框架,我们提议,如图1所示,由余留事项管理局分管的分公司(RGBM)。 在第一阶段,RGBM通过在无标签的提示上通过一个小的对流程序将每个域最差的残基最小化,从而得出零训练合并模型,从而确定组合权重. 然后通过域域奖励能量使剩余物正常化 形成域域余谱 这个频谱直接决定了什么,如果有什么的话,应该跟随合并. 标准的关节蒸馏往往会降解合并的模型,因为梯度来自低常态残基的域会腐蚀共享权重. 为防止这种干扰,第2阶段使这些域不受影响,只为闭式光谱缺口以上的域训练孤立的分支. 每个被承认的分支更新然后写回,缩放通过线性测试的最大系数.

blocks.en: Empirically, we validate our framework across two multi-teacher consolidation benchmarks: Open-MOPD ( Gao et al., 2026 ) (SmolLM3-3B with Math, Code, and Instruction Following specialists) and G-OPD ( Yang et al., 2026b ) (Qwen3-4B with Math and Code specialists). On Open-MOPD, the zero-training Phase 1 merge alone achieves a Macro average of 32.52 32.52 , outperforming the official 600 600 -step distilled student ( 30.93 30.93 ) without requiring any rollout compute. By passivating domains with low normalized residuals and training an isolated branch solely for Math, Phase 2 further elevates the Macro score to 33.03 33.03 with zero joint-training steps. Crucially, un-gated baselines such as TIES ( Yadav et al., 2023 ) , DARE ( Yu et al., 2024 ) , and continued joint distillation all fall below the merge, confirming that their updates can corrupt shared parameters. The same procedure transfers seamlessly to G-OPD, where RGBM surpasses the strongest trained baseline, demonstrating the generality of residual-governed consolidation.
blocks.zh: 从经验上讲,我们通过两个多教师巩固基准验证我们的框架:Open-MOPD(Gao等人,2026年)(SmolLM3-3B配数学、代码和指令跟踪专家)和G-OPD(Yang等人,2026年b)(Quen3-4B配数学和代码专家)。 在Open-MOPD中,单是零训练阶段1的合并就实现了32.52 32.52的宏平均值,比官方600 600步蒸馏生(30.93 30.93)的成绩要好,无需任何推出计算. 通过钝化低常态残基域,并为数学专门培训一个孤立的分支,第二阶段进一步将Macro分数提升到33.03 33.03分,采用零联训步骤. 关键是,TIES(Yadav等人,2023年),DARE(Yu等人,2024年)等未标定的基线,以及持续的联合蒸馏均落在合并之后,证实其更新会腐蚀共享参数. 同一程序无缝地向G-OPD转移,其中RGBM超过了训练最强的基准,表明剩余治理的合并是普遍的.

blocks.en:
(1) Theoretical Bridge: we establish a connection between multi-teacher on-policy distillation and model merging, showing that the MOPD objective coincides to second order with Fisher merging ( Matena and Raffel, 2022 ) , and derive an implicit-reward homomorphism that yields a label-free linear basin diagnostic.
(2) Two-Phase RGBM Framework: we propose Residual-Governed Branch-and-Merge (RGBM). Phase 1 computes the zero-training merge from a residual program on unlabelled prompts and forms an energy-normalized spectrum for cross-domain comparison. Phase 2 passivates domains below the spectral gap, trains isolated branches exclusively for domains above it, and writes admitted updates back via calibrated shrinkage.
(3) Empirical Validation and Protection Mechanism: across two model families (SmolLM3-3B and Qwen3-4B), Phase 1 alone matches or beats fully trained distillation, and Phase 2 advances performance further with zero joint-training steps. Crucially, un-gated write-backs fall below the merge, confirming that RGBM succeeds by shielding domains below the normalized spectral gap from cross-task interference.
blocks.zh:
(1)理论桥:我们建立多教师政策蒸馏和模型合并之间的联系,显示MOPD目标与费舍尔合并(Matena and Raffel, 2022)重合为第二顺序,并衍生出一种产生无标签线性盆地诊断的隐性奖励同位素.
(2) 双阶段RGBM 框架:我们提议设立余留事项管理处。 第1阶段从无标签的提示符上的剩余程序计算零训练合并,并形成能量常态化的频谱进行跨域比较. 第2阶段将光谱差距以下域钝化,专门为它上面域训练孤立的分支,并通过校准收缩写回所接受的更新.
(3)经验验证和保护机制:跨两个模范家庭(SmolLM3-3B和Quen3-4B),单是第1阶段匹配或击败经过充分训练的蒸馏,第2阶段以零联训步骤进一步推进性能. 关键是,未加标记的回写在合并下方,证实RGBM通过屏蔽在正常光谱间隙以下域免受跨任务干扰而成功.

blocks.en: 2 Merging Is Optimal, to Second Order, as a Closed-Form Stage of Distillation
blocks.zh: 2 合并为最佳状态, 到第二顺序, 作为封闭式蒸馏阶段

blocks.en: Section 2 establishes that parameter merging should precede distillation, and that whatever the linear combination leaves unrecovered is what a later stage must address. Residual-Governed Branch-and-Merge ( RGBM ; Figure 2 ; full procedure in Algorithm 1 , Appendix C.1 ) operationalizes this insight into two distinct phases. Phase 1 (Section 3.1 ) solves a convex subspace merge and then normalizes its per-domain remainders into the domain residual spectrum . After analyzing why continuing joint distillation degrades domains with low normalized residuals (Section 3.2 ), Phase 2 (Section 3.3 ) trains isolated branches exclusively for domains marked by the spectrum as unrecovered, writing them back via calibrated shrinkage.

The obvious second stage is to keep distilling θ 0 ⋆ \theta_{0}^{\star} jointly on all domains; Section 3.2 argued that this should erode the low-residual domains. Figure 4 tracks three joint objectives initialized from θ 0 ⋆ \theta_{0}^{\star} : Uniform (equal-weight reverse-KL), Outcome-Gated (matching the teacher only on failed rollouts), and Trust-Region (outcome-gated reverse-KL with a KL penalty β = 2.5 \beta=2.5 toward π θ 0 ⋆ \pi_{\theta_{0}^{\star}} ). Appendix C.2 extends this analysis to five distinct objectives.
(1) Low-residual domains deteriorate. At the last listed checkpoint of each recipe trained to step 20 20 or 50 50 , Code drops by 1.1 ∼ 2.9 1.1\sim 2.9 points below θ 0 ⋆ \theta_{0}^{\star} , IF falls behind the merge, and Macro stays in 30.5 ∼ 32.3 30.5\sim 32.3 . Joint distillation therefore undoes what Phase 1 had already recovered.
(2) High-residual Math improves only marginally. Uniform and Outcome-Gated trajectory means are 23.97 23.97 and 24.69 24.69 (Appendix C.2 ), against 23.86 23.86 at θ 0 ⋆ \theta_{0}^{\star} . Continued joint steps do not convert the Math residual into a gain that offsets the drop on Code and IF.
(3) Interference is parameter-level. Even when the Code reverse-KL is held below 10 − 3 10^{-3} nat/token, Code still degrades. The student can stay close to the Code teacher in distribution space, so the damage is coming from shared-weight updates, not from a Code-teacher mismatch.
(4) A token-level KL penalty cannot prevent collapse. The Trust-Region anchor bounds estimated policy drift to KL ^ ( π θ ∥ π θ 0 ⋆ ) ≈ 1.4 × 10 − 3 \widehat{\mathrm{KL}}(\pi_{\theta}\|\pi_{\theta_{0}^{\star}})\approx 1.4\times 10^{-3} nat/token, yet Macro decays to 31.25 31.25 by step 20 (Code drops 24.09 → 21.18 24.09\to 21.18 ). A scalar KL only restricts isotropic divergence; it does not block interference along the anisotropic directions captured by ℒ ¯ d \overline{\mathcal{L}}_{d} .

blocks.en: We stress what this does and does not show. Isolated branches raise their own domain under all three objectives (Appendix Table 11 ): IF by + 0.48 ∼ + 1.63 +0.48\sim+1.63 , Code by + 0.43 ∼ + 1.31 +0.43\sim+1.31 , and Math by + 0.58 ∼ + 1.83 +0.58\sim+1.83 . A low residual therefore does not mean a domain has nothing left to learn on its own: ℒ ¯ d \overline{\mathcal{L}}_{d} is the coupled gap at 𝜶 ⋆ \bm{\alpha}^{\star} , after all domains have been traded off together. A write-back is one shared update, so it moves domains other than the branch that was trained, and it is scored on Math, Code, and IF together. On that joint score the rejected IF write-back lowers Macro, while the admitted Math write-back raises it only at γ ⋆ = 0.125 \gamma^{\star}=0.125 . The spectrum chooses which branch may enter the shared model. The shrinkage grid chooses how far that branch may move it.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We bridge parameter merging and multi-teacher distillation by showing that to second order, the MOPD objective coincides with Fisher merging. Parameter merging is thus optimal, to second order, as a closed-form stage of distillation. For tractability, we restrict that merge to the task-vector subspace and, because the domain weights are unknown, replace them by their worst case: a residual program on unlabelled prompts yields the task-vector weights, and post-hoc reward-energy normalization yields the domain residual spectrum. Empirically, our zero-training merge beats a distilled student on Open-MOPD and approaches the strongest trained baseline on G-OPD, while residual-gated RGBM advances performance further. Un-gated write-backs degrade below the merge, confirming that post-merge gains are localized, with the normalized spectrum identifying the updates to test for safe write-back. Limitations are discussed in Appendix D .

blocks.en: To thoroughly investigate whether any joint fine-tuning objective could maintain or improve upon θ 0 ⋆ \theta_{0}^{\star} , we implemented and evaluated five distinct joint training recipes: 1. Standard Multi-Teacher Distillation (Uniform MOPD): Multi-teacher reverse-KL on student rollouts with equal domain sampling ( p d = 1 / 3 p_{d}=1/3 ). 2. Outcome-Gated Distillation: Outcome-gated on-policy distillation, where teacher distribution matching is active only when student reasoning fails verification. 3. Outcome-Veto Regularized Distillation: Regularized distillation applying explicit negative KL penalties to suppress drift on non-target domains. 4. Trust-Region Regularized Distillation: Outcome-gated distillation with explicit KL anchoring to θ 0 ⋆ \theta_{0}^{\star} ( β = 2.5 \beta=2.5 ). 5. Hybrid Teacher-Anchor Distillation: Convex combination of specialist teacher KL and student-to- θ 0 ⋆ \theta_{0}^{\star} anchor KL.
